:::{#exm-positive-agreement}
#### Positive agreement for the COVID-19 test

For the agreement table of @exm-agreement-table-covid,
the positive agreement (@def-positive-agreement) is:

$$
\ba
p_{\text{pos}}
&= \frac{2 \times 693}{2 \times 693 + 93 + 7}
&& \text{(definition of } p_{\text{pos}} \text{, with the table's counts)} \\
&= \frac{1{,}386}{1{,}386 + 93 + 7}
&& \text{(multiply)} \\
&= \frac{1{,}386}{1{,}486}
&& \text{(add)} \\
&\approx 0.933
&& \text{(divide)}
\ea
$$ {#eq-exm-positive-agreement}

The positive agreement is lower than the overall agreement (@exm-overall-agreement),
because the 93 false positives are large
relative to the 693 true positives.

:::
